PARAMS = {
    "fc":      (940e3, 920e3, 960e3),   # target -3 dB cutoff [Hz]; window is 912..968 kHz
    "R":       (100e3, 20e3, 500e3),    # common resistor [ohm]; caps scale as 1/(R*w0)
    "gmid_in": (12.0, 8.0, 16.0),       # nfet input pair gm/Id [S/A]
    "gmid_t":  (12.0, 8.0, 16.0),       # nfet tail / reference gm/Id [S/A]
    "gmid_p":  (10.0, 6.0, 14.0),       # pfet mirror-load gm/Id [S/A]
    "L_in":    (2.0, 1.0, 4.0),         # input pair length [um]
    "L_t":     (2.0, 1.0, 4.0),         # tail / reference length [um]
    "L_p":     (2.0, 1.0, 4.0),         # pfet load length [um]
    "I_tail":  (45e-6, 30e-6, 60e-6),   # tail current per OTA [A]
}

def design(p, lut, spec):
    VDD = 1.8
    iref = spec.get("iref", 10e-6)
    fc = p["fc"]
    R = p["R"]
    w0 = 2 * PI * fc

    # Bias: nfet reference diode on ibias, tail mirrors share the same gm/Id and L
    mref = lut.size("n", p["gmid_t"], p["L_t"], iref, vds=0.6, vsb=0.0)
    mtail = lut.size("n", p["gmid_t"], p["L_t"], p["I_tail"], vds=0.2, vsb=0.0)
    # Input pair: each device carries half the tail current, source ~0.2 V above vss
    min_ = lut.size("n", p["gmid_in"], p["L_in"], p["I_tail"] / 2, vds=0.5, vsb=0.2)
    # PMOS mirror load: diode and output device identical (same L, gm/Id, Id)
    mld = lut.size("p", p["gmid_p"], p["L_p"], p["I_tail"] / 2, vds=0.6, vsb=0.0)

    n = Netlist("vin vout vdd vss ibias")
    n.dev("MREF", "ibias", "ibias", "vss", "vss", mref)

    def ota(tag, vp, vn, vo):
        # 5T OTA, nfet input pair, pfet mirror load, unity-gain follower use (vn tied to vo)
        tN = "tail_" + tag
        d1 = "d1_" + tag
        n.dev("MT" + tag, tN, "ibias", "vss", "vss", mtail)
        n.dev("MA" + tag, d1, vp, tN, "vss", min_)   # M1: diode side, non-inverting input
        n.dev("MB" + tag, vo, vn, tN, "vss", min_)   # M2: output side, inverting input
        n.dev("MP" + tag, d1, d1, "vdd", "vdd", mld) # M3 diode
        n.dev("MQ" + tag, vo, d1, "vdd", "vdd", mld) # M4 output mirror

    # Stage 0: first-order RC pole (w = w0), buffered by OTA follower
    Cp = 1.0 / (R * w0)
    n.R("R0", "vin", "xp", R)
    n.C("C0", "xp", "vss", Cp)
    ota("0", "xp", "o0", "o0")

    # Stage 1: Sallen-Key LPF, Q1 = 0.618, unity gain.
    # Equal resistors: C1 = 2Q/(R w0) (feedback cap), C2 = 1/(2Q R w0) (ground cap)
    Q1 = 0.618
    C1a = 2 * Q1 / (R * w0)
    C2a = 1.0 / (2 * Q1 * R * w0)
    n.R("Ra1", "o0", "n1a", R)
    n.R("Rb1", "n1a", "n2a", R)
    n.C("Cf1", "n1a", "o1", C1a)
    n.C("Cg1", "n2a", "vss", C2a)
    ota("1", "n2a", "o1", "o1")

    # Stage 2: Sallen-Key LPF, Q2 = 1.618, unity gain -> vout
    Q2 = 1.618
    C1b = 2 * Q2 / (R * w0)
    C2b = 1.0 / (2 * Q2 * R * w0)
    n.R("Ra2", "o1", "n1b", R)
    n.R("Rb2", "n1b", "n2b", R)
    n.C("Cf2", "n1b", "vout", C1b)
    n.C("Cg2", "n2b", "vss", C2b)
    ota("2", "n2b", "vout", "vout")

    # Analytic predictions
    atten_db = 10.0 * math.log10(1.0 + 10.0 ** (2 * 5))   # 5th-order Butterworth at 10*fc, ~100 dB
    power = VDD * (iref + 3.0 * p["I_tail"])
    return n, {
        "fc": fc,
        "atten_db": atten_db,
        "peaking_db": 0.0,
        "gain_db": 0.0,
        "power": power,
    }
